query:
SELECT EXISTS(
            SELECT 1 FROM wireguard_network wn
            WHERE wn.location_mfa_mode = 'disabled'
            AND (
                wn.allow_all_groups
                OR EXISTS(
                    SELECT 1 FROM wireguard_network_allowed_group wnag
                    JOIN "group" g ON g.id = wnag.group_id
                    WHERE wnag.network_id = wn.id
                    AND g.name = ANY($1)
                )
            )
        )
